opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect as a way to place $5,000 and receive substantial recurring returns, reporting that the investment was “paying out weekly” and that personal weekly payments reached “between $350 to $450 a week.” The speaker further describes a five-month outcome in which $5,000 placed into BitConnect produces $10,000, then directs viewers to click an affiliate link and sign up. The supplied page imagery reinforces the investment solicitation through BitConnect branding, lending and staking labels, and an “INVEST NOW” prompt, although the exact relationship between those elements is not established. A disclaimer, an affordability warning, and uncertainty about BitConnect’s longevity do not remove the stated return claims or referral request.
